surface_value: There are several types of anxiety diseases with the main symptoms being fear and excessive need to worry. Panic attacks happen frequently for those who are diagnosed with anxiety disorders. In case of an attack, the patient experiences the following symptoms; a headache, irrational fear, nervousness, nausea and sometimes vomiting.
